children: Yields on U.K. government bonds, or gilts, edge lower as demand for safe-haven assets rises due to fears about AI companies' future profitability. Market focus is also on the U.S. midterm elections, the Bank of England interest rate decision and the U.S. jobs data set to be released this week. Investors widely expect the BOE to increase interest rates to 4.0% at Thursday's policy meeting, LSEG data show. Ten-year gilt yields fall 2.6 basis points to last trade at 5.260%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
